status: Scoped window restoration and shared checkpoint-read lifetimes integrated; full acceptance remains open
implementation: Window query restoration uses the shared admitted JSON parser, validates parsed state without cloning it, and compares window definitions using admitted stable comparison.
Restored rows acquire independent owned payloads before each parsed run is released. Input buffering reuses exact known row and directory owners, avoiding a second detached copy.
Restored run directories and sliced run references reserve storage before allocation. Query timing and cancellation checks now include restoration and run reads.

The checkpoint spill-read helper is shared with aggregate, sort and top-k restoration. Owned adapters admit read buffers before allocation; legacy read-only adapters now charge returned buffers while retained.
Validation traverses record values without allocating Object.values directories.

default.note: Full run before adding the final cancellation regression and expanding the fixture matrix; production sources unchanged afterward.

scope: Encoded and object checkpoint restoration at measured exact peak and one byte below
Manifest and run resume uses owned reads instead of read
Malformed JSON and invalid row shape cleanup
Cancellation pins the in-flight owned buffer until settlement, then rejects before parsing

http.scope: Expanded real Parquet matrix resumes inline encoded state and spilled state over HTTP 206 and ignored-Range 200 responses, row/vector source paths and shared 64/128 MiB pools.

worker.scope: Full local workerd suite rerun with the expanded real Parquet R2 resume matrix.

validation.build: pnpm exec tsc -b passed before runtime tests
validation.limitations: Coverage, external conformance, full packaging and performance benchmarks were not refreshed for this change.

remainingAcceptance: Legacy SpillAdapter.read allocates externally before the engine can inspect byte length; post-read retention accounting is not pre-allocation admission. Only readOwned provides that contract.
Window planning/frame-bound expression workspaces and remaining metadata, delegated task output and other source/operator gaps remain open.
Transactional cleanup of already-created spill objects and adapter-owned persistent storage remain separate from in-flight read/parse/write accounting.
Full mixed-job/adaptive scheduling acceptance and production Cloudflare total-memory evidence remain open.
Shared reservations do not establish a total VM heap, external backing or RSS cap.
